tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Solar Power Development Corporation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Karnataka Solar Power Development Corporation Limited Head Office Bengalore

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document. Bidder shall adhere to terms & conditions stipulated in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have carried out similar works to an extent of cumulative of Rs.1,40,00,000/- in Central/state PSUs/private sector in the last 5 years. The Tenderer shall have to upload the supporting Documents such as Work order copies, order completion certificates/performance certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order copies, order completion certificates/performance certificates

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) Registration and shall upload the necessary supporting documents.
The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any State/Central Utilities/PSUs in the last 5 years.
The Tenderer should not be under order of debarment/blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any State/Central Utilities/PSUs, as on the date of bid submission of bids.

The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Bidder Shall upload Registration certificate/Partnership Deed/license issued by the Commerce & Industries Department or any other Government Statutory Authority shall be uploaded. For Proprietorship firm, PAN and GST registration certificate shall be uploaded. Tenders from consortium/JV are not acceptable.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate/Partnership Deed/license issued by the Commerce & Industries Department or any other Government Statutory Authority

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have PAN Registration and shall upload the necessary supporting documents.

Any Tender/Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section-XII of the tender documents under the heading - Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration for having read the clauses specified in Section-XII

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years in the last five years (i.e. from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26) a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 3.50 Crores. The Tenderer shall upload the Audited Financial statements i.e. Balance sheets Profit and Loss statements, Annual Turnover Certificates for the last 5 years duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
Others -- Audited Financial statements i.e. Balance sheets Profit and Loss statements for the last 5 years

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall upload ITR Filed copy for the last five years (i.e. from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26)

The Tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of Bid.
The Tenderer shall upload the Power of Attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.500/- non-judicial stamp paper. (Appendix-c of Section-VIII)
DETAILS OF THE TENDERER- APPENDIX B (Section-VIII)

General Declaration of Bidder shall be uploaded: Declaration that the Bidder has carefully examined the Bidding Documents in totality and his authorised personnel have visited the site for assessment of all factors for the purposes of bidding.
